title: Research intake center for external references
statement: Provide a structured intake that accepts repo/article/paper/competitor/conversation sources and produces source cards, patterns, ideas and open questions without automatically changing product scope.
problem: External references currently require manual intake discipline.
smallest_test: Create one structured source intake and verify it yields source/pattern/idea/open-question records.

title: Idea promotion by repeated evidence/friction
statement: Track recurrence and evidence so repeated real friction promotes an idea while speculative novelty remains backlog.
problem: Novel ideas can outrun repeated real-world friction/evidence.
smallest_test: Track recurrence and compare candidate idea promotion over several cycles.

title: Company 360 as canonical commercial context surface
statement: As Company/Contact become canonical, expose a fast Company 360 view with decision-maker, next action, timeline and quick actions.
problem: Current client context is fragmented across views/records.
smallest_test: Ship the smallest canonical Company/Contact view showing decision-maker and next action.
